standard_prerequisites.name: Exact sequences of Picard groups for a regular model and torsion subgroups
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a regular model the Picard group of the model surjects onto that of the curve with kernel determined by the multiplicities of the special fibre, and there is a canonical map from the Picard group of the curve to the combinatorial Picard group of the numerical type whose kernel consists of the restrictions of invertible sheaves of degree zero on every component; an invertible sheaf whose restriction to each component has degree zero becomes torsion of order dividing the gcd of the multiplicities after raising to a suitable power. The author's own lemmas of this section are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted sequence is the tool used in this section to compare the h-torsion of the three Picard groups for an order h coprime to the gcd of the multiplicities, which is the shape needed for the semistable-reduction results.

core_obligations: Take h-torsion in the exact sequence of the regular model: because h is coprime to the gcd of the multiplicities, the kernel of the restriction map has no h-torsion, so the h-torsion of the Picard group of the model injects into the h-torsion of the Picard group of the curve (source lines 5973-5977).

Use the canonical map to the Picard group of the numerical type, restricted to h-torsion, to continue the sequence, and note that it annihilates the h-torsion classes coming from the model (source lines 5978-5981).

Exactness in the middle: given an h-torsion class on the curve that dies in the Picard group of the numerical type, realise it as the restriction of an invertible sheaf on the model all of whose degrees on the components vanish (source lines 5982-5986).

Correct the exponent: the h-th tensor power of that sheaf is torsion of order dividing the gcd of the multiplicities, so multiplying the exponent by an inverse of that gcd modulo h produces an exponent whose power of the sheaf is h-torsion and still restricts to the given class (source lines 5986-5992).

proof_roadmap.step: Take h-torsion in the exact sequence of the regular model, using coprimality of h and the gcd.
Continue the sequence with the canonical map to the Picard group of the numerical type.
Lift a class in the middle to a degree-zero invertible sheaf on the model.
Apply a Bezout correction to the exponent to get an h-torsion sheaf with the same restriction.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-sequence-torsion（源 5962-5970 行，证明 5972-5992 行）：取 d=gcd(m_1,…,m_n)、h 与 d 互素，则存在正合列 0→Pic(X)[h]→Pic(C)[h]→Pic(T)[h]。关键操作不是例行核验：第一步要对同章的正则模型 Picard 正合列取 h-挠，并利用 h 与 d 互素说明核里没有 h-挠（5973-5977 行）；中间正合性要把「ξ 在 Pic(T)[h] 中为零」翻译成「存在 X 上每个 C_i 上度数为 0 的可逆层 L 其限制为 ξ」（5982-5986 行）；最后一步必须用 L^{⊗h} 的阶整除 d 这一信息，取 d′ 使 dd′≡1 (mod h)，再用 L^{⊗dd′} 把 ξ 提升为 h-挠（5986-5992 行）。难点在于「除以 gcd」与「模 h 求逆」两处算术与引理 restriciton 的拼接，缺一步都得不到 h-挠的提升；原文位置在证明的 5973-5977、5978-5981、5982-5986、5986-5992 行。
